title: Dominar 400 Touring Edition (Adventure Spec)
description: Representing Bajaj Auto's prowess in the Urban Roadster class, the Bajaj Auto Dominar 400 Touring Edition (Adventure Spec) is delivers all-weather long-haul versatility with long-travel suspension compliance. A 400cc powerplant pumps out 44 HP and 38 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
